title: 第21章 威胁女帝者死第22章 叶家竟然姬扶摇麾下
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 不多时。
黑炎山脉外围，姬扶摇突然停下了。
她目光幽冷，看向身后的密林，冷冷道，“都出来吧。”
声音落下！
刀疤男子几人目露淫光，舔着嘴唇，冷笑着走了出来。
“这位姑娘，与其死在凶残的灵兽腹中，不如满足一下我们兄弟几人。你觉得如何？”
“你放心，你这种美人我们会很温柔的，不会弄疼你的……桀桀桀！”
姬扶摇一脸厌恶，就要取出圣阶符篆。
要知道这一次外出，陆玄已经将她武装到牙齿了。
即使半帝来狙击她，都得死在这里！
姬扶摇正要出手，突然虚空之上，一道无比恐怖绝伦的气息涌动。
准帝境威压！
半帝境威压！
磅礴浩荡的威压之力如渊似海，排山倒海一般向着这一方天地倾泻而来，这一刻，如同天地凝滞。
刀疤男子几人无比震惊，抬头向着远处望去。
什么情况？
在黑炎山脉外围怎么会出现如此强者？
一道血斧在虚空之上闪烁，暴戾之气冲天，直接呼啸向着刀疤男子几人冲了过来。
血斧呼啸，如同断头台！
顷刻间，刀疤男子几人的脑袋直接飞了出去！
鲜血爆溅！
“胆敢觊觎女帝陛下，死！”
一道冰寒的声音出现。
下一瞬间。
数道身影轰然落在姬扶摇的面前。
“扑通！”
“扑通！”
这几道身影直接跪在了姬扶摇的面前。
姬扶摇雪颈微倾，眼中神华流转，仔细打量着眼前几人。
“起来吧。”
“王蛮，青烟……你们来了……”
她有些动容。
三千年了，终于见到了她的龙卫。
闻言，龙卫统领王蛮和青烟两人身体颤抖，其他几人也是无比激动的看着姬扶摇。
是女帝陛下的气息没错了！
content_en:
Not long after.
Outside the Black Flame Mountain Range, Ji Fuyao suddenly stopped.
She looked coldly at the dense forest behind her and said coldly, "Come out."
The sound falls!
The men with scars showed lustful eyes, licked their lips, and walked out with a sneer.
"This girl, instead of dying in the belly of a ferocious spiritual beast, it would be better for us brothers to be satisfied. What do you think?"
"Don't worry, we will be very gentle to a beauty like you and won't hurt you... Jie Jie Jie!"
Ji Fuyao looked disgusted and was about to take out the Holy Order Talisman Seal.
You must know that this time out, Lu Xuan had armed her to the teeth.
Even if the Half-Emperor comes to snipe her, he will die here!
Ji Fuyao was about to take action when suddenly an extremely terrifying aura surged in the void.
Quasi-emperor realm pressure!
The pressure of the Half-Emperor Realm!
The majestic and mighty coercive force is like a deep ocean, pouring towards this side of the world like an overwhelming mountain. At this moment, it is like the heaven and the earth are stagnant.
The scarred man and the others were extremely shocked and looked up into the distance.
What's going on?
How could such a powerful person appear outside the Black Flame Mountains?
"Tsk!"
A blood ax flashed in the void, its violent energy soared into the sky, and it roared directly towards the scarred man and the others.
The blood ax roars like a guillotine!
In an instant, the heads of the scarred man flew out!
"Poof! Poof! Poof!"
Blood splatters!
"You dare to covet Her Majesty the Empress, die!"
A cold voice appeared.
The next moment.
Several figures suddenly landed in front of Ji Fuyao.
"Plop!"
"Plop!"
These figures knelt directly in front of Ji Fuyao.
Ji Fuyao tilted her snowy neck slightly, her eyes sparkling, and she carefully looked at the people in front of her.
"Get up."
"Wang Man, Qing Yan...you are here..."
She was a little moved.
After three thousand years, she finally met her Dragon Guard.
Hearing this, Longwei commanders Wang Man and Qing Yan trembled, and several others looked at Ji Fuyao with great excitement.
It’s the aura of Her Majesty the Empress!
"His Majesty……"
title_en: Chapter 21 Anyone who threatens the empress will die Chapter 22 The Ye family is actually under Ji Fuyao's command
